blocks.prompt: 9. Find three consecutive numbers in G.P. whose sum is 26 and their product is 216.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh ek word problem hai jis mein teen anjaane numbers G.P. mein hain.
Diya kya hai? Un ka jama (sum) 26 aur zarb (product) 216.
Find kya karna hai? Teenon numbers.
Plan: numbers ko samajhdari se \(\frac{a}{r}, a, ar\) maanenge, taake product mein \(r\) khud cancel ho jaye. Pehle product se \(a\), phir sum se \(r\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: G.P. ke teen numbers, sum 26, product 216.
Humein find karna hai: woh teen numbers.
Tareeqa: Agar beech wala number \(a\) ho to us se pehla \(\frac{a}{r}\) aur baad wala \(ar\) hoga. Yeh chunaao (selection) is liye behtar hai ke product lete waqt \(r\) aur \(\frac{1}{r}\) cancel ho jate hain aur seedha \(a\) mil jata hai. \(a, ar, ar^2\) lene se bhi ho jata, lekin hisaab lamba hota.

Product se \(a\) nikalein
\[\dfrac{a}{r} \cdot a \cdot ar = 216\]
\[a^3 = 216 \Rightarrow a = 6\]
Kyun: \(\frac{a}{r} \times ar\) mein \(r\) cancel hua aur \(a^2\) bacha; phir \(a\) se multiply kar ke \(a^3\). Woh number jise teen dafa multiply karein to 216 aaye, 6 hai (\(6 \times 6 \times 6 = 216\)).

Sum se \(r\) ki equation
\[\dfrac{6}{r} + 6 + 6r = 26\]
\[6 + 6r + 6r^2 = 26r\]
\[6r^2 - 20r + 6 = 0\]
\[3r^2 - 10r + 3 = 0\]
Kyun: Fraction \(\frac{6}{r}\) hatane ke liye har term ko \(r\) se multiply kiya. Phir sab kuch ek taraf la kar quadratic equation (do darje wali equation) banayi aur poori ko 2 se divide kar ke chhota kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(r\) se multiply karte waqt right side ka 26 bhi \(26r\) banta hai; usay bhool jana aam ghalti hai.

Quadratic solve karein
\[(3r - 1)(r - 3) = 0\]
\[r = 3 \text{ or } r = \tfrac{1}{3}\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product \(3 \times 3 = 9\) aur sum \(-10\) ho: \(-9\) aur \(-1\). \(-10r = -9r - r\) likh kar jore banaye: \(3r(r - 3) - 1(r - 3)\), phir \((r - 3)\) common liya.

Numbers likhein
\[r = 3:\ 2, 6, 18\]
\[r = \tfrac{1}{3}:\ 18, 6, 2\]
Kyun: \(a = 6\) aur har \(r\) ko \(\frac{a}{r}, a, ar\) mein rakha. \(\frac{1}{3}\) se divide karna 3 se multiply karne jaisa hai. Dono values se wohi teen numbers aate hain, sirf tarteeb ulti hai, kyunke \(r\) aur \(\frac{1}{r}\) ek doosre ka ulat hain.

Tasdeeq
\[2 + 6 + 18 = 26\ \checkmark\]
\[2 \times 6 \times 18 = 216\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: Sum aur product dono sharait poori hain, aur \(6/2 = 18/6 = 3\) se G.P. bhi pakki hai.
